summary: feat(settings): add the PairConnectHint supplicant page
description:
Because:

* iOS users who scan the v2 pairing QR with the system camera land on
  /pair/unsupported in whatever browser opened the link.
* FXA-14595 adds a "continue in Firefox" choice there, and needs a mobile
  screen that tells a user who already has Firefox how to scan the code
  again from inside the app.

This commit:

* Adds Pair2/Supplicant/PairConnectHint with the Firefox wordmark, the
  phone illustration, a two-step card and a "Learn more" link.
* Reuses MobileDevicePairingImage; the Figma export is the same asset.
* Tags the link with the dtm_mobile_connect_hint_learn_more Glean click id.
* Registers a lazy import and the /pair/supplicant/connect_hint route.
* Adds Fluent strings, a Default story and unit tests.

Closes #FXA-14603
